claims.claim_text: The indexed Philip Bastedo is high-confidence matched to the federal official later documented with the Strategic Services Unit in Berlin.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The uncommon exact name appears in the index, in 1942-1943 official federal appointment records, and as the creator of a 1945 Strategic Services Unit record.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact name and a continuous official wartime chronology culminating in an institutional Strategic Services Unit catalog record.
claims.temporal_assessment: Official records place Bastedo in OCD and Lend-Lease in 1942-1943; Cornell identifies him with the Strategic Services Unit in October 1945.
claims.match_notes: High rather than confirmed because the physical Box 41 personnel file has not been examined and the index prints no rank or identifier for this row.

claims.claim_text: The Office of Lend-Lease Administration is the probable, not confirmed, immediate pre-OSS affiliation for Philip Bastedo.
claims.evidence_excerpt: resigned as deputy director ... to accept a position with the Office of Lend-Lease Administration
claims.evidence_paraphrase: An official March 1943 bulletin records Bastedo's move from OCD to Lend-Lease. A secondary chronology places his Naval Reserve and OSS service beginning in 1943.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The rare exact name and later Strategic Services Unit record support the same person.
claims.temporal_assessment: Probable immediate: the move to Lend-Lease and reported OSS service both fall in 1943, but no source explicitly joins the two transitions or supplies an OSS entry month.
claims.match_notes: The public wording preserves the uncertainty. This claim is excluded from default high-confidence analytics until the personnel file or another direct chronology is reviewed.
